scientific_integrity: Exact conditional-mean theorem proved by classical forest-extension enumeration, leaf-deletion bijections, and discrete sign factorization; finite checks supplement but do not replace proof. The forest count and endpoint-degree conditional law are acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Only uniform unrooted labeled Cayley trees and conditional expectations are covered. Older equivalent generating functions may exist. The cube-root-optimal distance gains only a finite limiting excess over the unconditional leaf mean. Historical priority is not independently verified.
title: A cubic-optimal marked distance for expected leaves in uniform labeled trees
